data.one_liner: A lightweight, flexible web server framework for building APIs and backend services in Dart.
data.what_it_does: Relic is a high-performance web server framework inspired by Shelf. It features a built-in trie-based router, strongly typed APIs with validated HTTP headers, static file handling with cache busting, and built-in WebSocket support.
use_when: You want to build a backend service or REST API in Dart.
You are looking for an alternative to Shelf with a built-in trie router and typed APIs.
You need built-in WebSocket support and static file handling for your web application.
avoid_when: You are building a client-side Flutter application UI.
You need client-side utilities rather than a server-side framework.
strengths: Strongly typed APIs and validated HTTP headers.
Built-in trie-based router for improved performance.
Out-of-the-box WebSocket support and static file handling.
weaknesses: Requires migration or adjustment if you are deeply accustomed to standard Shelf ecosystem packages.
data.setup_notes: Install Dart 3.7 or newer and run 'dart pub add relic'.

alternatives.name: shelf
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you prefer the mature and widely adopted original middleware-based web server framework for Dart.
